title: Victorian hallway
alt: Timber stairs beside a black and cream geometric tiled hallway.
description: The tiled border follows the turn of the staircase. A repeating black and cream pattern draws the eye from the front hall through to the next room.

title: Kitchen fit-out
alt: A U-shaped kitchen with dark cabinets, timber worktops, a white sink and a star-patterned floor.
description: Dark cabinetry wraps around three sides of this Fairview kitchen. Timber worktops and a deep white sink sit above a floor of repeating star tiles.

title: Georgian office fit-out
alt: A Georgian entrance with a dark stair runner, blue armchair and globe pendant.
description: A stair runner, a blue armchair and a glass-topped table define the reception area. A globe pendant hangs over the foot of the stairs.

title: Victorian bathroom
alt: A Victorian-style tiled floor seen through an open door, with a terracotta and charcoal border.
description: Seen from the doorway, the floor has a pattern of cream, charcoal and terracotta tiles. A dark outer border picks up the line of the room.

title: Georgian bathroom
alt: Two white basin cabinets beneath a wide mirror above a black and white patterned floor.
description: Two separate basin units sit side by side beneath one mirror. White wall tiles give the patterned floor room to stand out.

title: Apartment fit-out
alt: An apartment bathroom with a curved shower enclosure, dark textured walls and a geometric floor.
description: In the apartment bathroom, a curved shower enclosure leaves space at the centre of the floor. Dark textured wall panels meet a pale geometric tile.
